@Dogecoin_Dan @Lisa9Sophia @NickFeik Australia has successfully settled refugees from all over the world, Dan.

And the current agitation about the Palestinian people mirrors past prejudice against refugees from Vietnam, Bosnia, Syria, Afghanistan and other then-war zones.

@Dogecoin_Dan @Lisa9Sophia @NickFeik Nothing is certain except death & taxes, Dan, as the saying goes.

However, Australia has a long and proud history of resettling refugees from conflict zones, and our processes are designed to assess & support people fleeing persecution.
